meta.name: test-driven-development
meta.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code

copy.tagline: 先写测试再写代码，驱动功能实现
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果习惯用测试驱动开发流程
copy.tagline_en: Write tests before code to drive feature implementation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you practice test-driven development

howto.what: 当你实现新功能或修复bug时，Claude会强制你按测试驱动开发流程：先写一个会失败的测试，然后写最少代码让测试通过，最后重构。每一步都要求验证测试结果。
howto.when: 当你开始实现新功能、修复bug、重构或改变行为时触发。如果是一次性原型或配置文件等例外，会先询问你是否跳过。

say.text: 我要添加用户登录功能，先写测试。
say.note: Claude会指导你写一个会失败的测试。

say.text: 帮我写一个测试，验证它失败。
say.note: Claude会编写测试并运行确认失败。

howto.what_en: When implementing a new feature or fixing a bug, Claude enforces test-driven development: write a failing test, write minimal code to pass, then refactor. It verifies each step with test runs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start implementing a new feature, fixing a bug, refactoring, or changing behavior. Exceptions (throwaway prototypes, config files) require asking your permission first.

say_en.text: I want to add user login. Let's write the test first.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through writing a failing test.

say_en.text: Help me write a test and verify it fails.
say_en.note: Claude writes the test and runs it to confirm failure.
